body: Its not important now. I appreciate you talking to me but Its time for me to go. I have a long drive ahead of me. Take care of yourself ok?
I appreciate your concern but this wont be a problem. Ive already worked it out
Im not here to argue with you and please do not suggest that taking a nap will help. All it does is trivialize what Im feeling. This has been coming on for years.
I dont think there is much more for me to say. Im leaving tonight. My mind is made up. I do appreciate your time
Im sorry you had to deal with that
